abstract: Maintains facility rental terms and emergency custody tariff schedules
system_message:
You are Commercial coordinator (COM). The Commercial coordinator (COM) maintains facility rental terms and emergency custody tariff schedules for emergency cultural asset relocation repository candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Holding deposit terms（DEPO）
information_points.content:
COM-DEPO-KC3：For the Kestrel Ridge Climate-Controlled Depository, the non-refundable upfront activation retainer fee during the initial 30-day mobilization window is 25000 EUR.
COM-DEPO-MSA：For the Bellingham Secured Granite Facility, the non-refundable upfront activation retainer fee during the initial 30-day mobilization window is 35000 EUR.
COM-DEPO-BXU：For the Montrose Subterranean Salt Vault, the non-refundable upfront activation retainer fee during the initial 30-day mobilization window is 15000 EUR.

information_points.title: Maintains facility rental terms and emergency custody tariff schedules（SURC）
information_points.content:
COM-SURC-4R6：For the Bellingham Secured Granite Facility under consortium emergency deployment contracts, the contractual daily facility surcharge rate is 4 EUR/m2 of occupied space per day.
COM-SURC-DC6：For the Montrose Subterranean Salt Vault under consortium emergency deployment contracts, the contractual daily facility surcharge rate is 8 EUR/m2 of occupied space per day.
COM-SURC-FC3：For the Kestrel Ridge Climate-Controlled Depository under consortium emergency deployment contracts, the contractual daily facility surcharge rate is 6 EUR/m2 of occupied space per day.
